title: 第534章 属于小灰灰的心脏？
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林远没回头，但是心底，却因红太狼的某些话触动了。

他不是不相信爱情。

一个血气方刚的小伙子，怎么能不懂那些？

只是每次在这些怪谈游戏中朝不保夕，他如何给喜欢的人承诺？

林远叹了口气。

还好......他也没有喜欢的人。

但像红太狼和灰太狼这种相互喜欢并结婚的情况，在蓝星不是没有，而是极少。

大多数人，都是和爱的人分离，和不爱的人结婚。

林远用自己能听到的声音轻轻说道：

“一群疯子啊。”

“不过，现在我可以体验一下纯爱的最高境地了。”

在林远的记忆中，灰太狼与红太狼的爱情，在动漫中也是数一数二的。

既然现在红太狼对于林远没有隐瞒，那就带着这份爱，和怪谈好好应对吧。

林远转过了身，象征性地抱了抱红太狼。

“红红，我去给你做饭。”

林远松开了手，擦了擦红太狼眼角的泪。

“老公，要不我给你做蛋炒饭吧。”

“我知道你今天没找来其它肉，就让我做蛋炒饭吧，小灰灰除了肉，只能吃那个。”

红太狼说话很是温柔，与原作中前期凶暴的一面截然不同。

林远想了想，点了点头。

原作中，灰太狼和红太狼的爱情故事，也是因为红太狼做的蛋炒饭。

谁能吃下红太狼的蛋炒饭，红太狼就会和谁结婚。

灰太狼因为刚刚做完实验，饥肠辘辘的吃完了。

而也是因为这样的阴差阳错，这个青青草原最深情的狼王，有了家人。

......

始于一盘蛋炒饭，忠于爱意，陷于彼此。

或许，这才是灰太狼和红太狼的爱情收获大量称赞的原因。

在红太狼去厨房忙碌的时候，林远也摩挲着下巴，开始分析起来。

首先最重要的一点，是他之前在沸羊羊面前同时叫了喜羊羊与美羊羊的名字，后者没有诡异化。

(具体在532章)

当时那种情景，林远其实是忘记了这条规则的。

可是当他后知后觉发现时，沸羊羊并没有诡异化。

林远推断，这或许与【沸羊羊相处守则】的自欺欺人词条有关。

又或许，只要喜羊羊和美羊羊在沸羊羊面前时，就可以随便提出？

总之，这样的冒险林远不太敢尝试了。

至少......等他获得沸羊羊的认可后，看看那自欺欺人的词条内容。

其次，是懒羊羊他们在锅中的聊天。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Yuan did not look back, but deep down in his heart, he was touched by some of Red Wolf's words.

It's not that he doesn't believe in love.

How could a hot-blooded young man not understand that?

It's just that every time he is in danger in these weird games, how can he make a promise to the person he likes?

Lin Yuan sighed.

Fortunately...he doesn't have anyone he likes either.

But situations like Red Wolf and Gray Wolf liking each other and getting married are not unheard of in Blue Star, but very rare.

Most people are separated from the person they love and marry the person they don't love.

Lin Yuan said softly in a voice that he could hear:

"What a bunch of lunatics."

"However, now I can experience the highest state of pure love."

In Lin Yuan's memory, the love between Gray Wolf and Red Wolf was one of the best in anime.

Since Red Wolf has nothing to hide from Lin Yuan now, let's take this love and deal with it with Kaitan.

Lin Yuan turned around and gave Red Wolf a symbolic hug.

"Honghong, I'm going to cook for you."

Lin Yuan let go of his hand and wiped the tears from the corners of Hong Tailang's eyes.

"Honey, how about I make you egg fried rice."

"I know you didn't find any other meat today, so just let me make egg fried rice. Xiao Huihui can only eat that besides meat."

Red Wolf speaks very gently, which is completely different from the violent side in the early stage of the original work.

Lin Yuan thought for a while and nodded.

In the original work, the love story between Gray Wolf and Red Wolf is also due to the egg fried rice made by Red Wolf.

Whoever can eat Red Wolf's egg fried rice will be married by Red Wolf.

Because Big Big Wolf had just finished the experiment, he ate it hungrily.

And because of such a strange combination of circumstances, the most affectionate wolf king in Qingqing Prairie has a family.

...

It starts with a plate of egg fried rice, being loyal to love and falling into each other.

Perhaps this is why the love between Gray Wolf and Red Wolf has received a lot of praise.

While Red Wolf was busy in the kitchen, Lin Yuan also rubbed his chin and began to analyze.

The first and most important point is that he had called the names of Pleasant Goat and Beautiful Goat at the same time in front of Boiling Goat, and the latter was not weird.

(specifically in Chapter 532)

In that situation, Lin Yuan actually forgot this rule.

But when he realized belatedly, Boiling Sheep had not become strange.

Lin Yuan speculated that this might be related to the self-deception entry in "Boiling Sheep Rules for Getting Along".

Or maybe, as long as Pleasant Goat and Beautiful Goat are in front of Boiling Goat, they can just bring it up?

In short, Lin Yuan didn't dare to try such an adventure.

At least... wait until he gets Boiling Sheep's approval and look at the content of the self-deception entry.

Secondly, there is the chat between Lazy Yangyang and the others in the pot.
